name: North Carolina
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. North Carolina's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): the Tennessee line in the west, the South Carolina line in the south, Virginia in the north, and Cape Hatteras on the Outer Banks in the east. Open Atlantic beyond the Outer Banks is trimmed; Pamlico Sound and the ocean south of Cape Lookout inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-nc.
